title: Known-truth functional-response isomorphism camera calibration
objective: Calibrate four frozen cameras on response processes with known coordinate identity, monotone depth warp, event permutation, redundant realization, and non-isomorphic functional negatives before any free-network claim.
primary_claim: A coordinate-free response camera identifies held-out functional families across physical realizations while identity coordinates fail on deliberately warped or permuted implementations.
claim_boundaries: This is an artificial known-truth camera calibration, not a learned Transformer or language-mechanism result.
A response spectrum can identify a quotient without providing an event-to-event map.
A monotone warp can align ordered events but cannot authorize arbitrary event permutation.
Exact physical identity is unidentifiable for response-equivalent gauge twins and must be refused.
hard_stops: No confirmation label, threshold, camera family, noise seed, or physical transform may change after preregistration.
Failure blocks C021 free-network execution until the camera contract is replaced in a new campaign.
Passing WP00 authorizes only the frozen multi-task free-network test, not rescue or pretrained-model transfer.
